trap-superlative.evidence: 'The photon spectrum saturates the categorical state space.' and 'the unique gauge coupling compatible with the completeness pairing.' Both read as maximum-strength on the surface, but each is a technical predicate the chapter goes on to define (saturation of a state space; uniqueness of a solution), not an unqualified intensifier. Judged as content, not inflation.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Three noun-chain sentences in a 1 kB block: 'The Plancherel-ratio Gram determinant defines the spectral measure.'; 'This connects to the Chern--Simons action and the kappa-spectral interpretation of the Gram-matrix determinant.'; 'The Bring zero-mode controls the precision-target gap.' Each stacks two or three hyphenated technical compounds into subject and object with no intervening structure, so the sentences carry no spoken rhythm -- written for the eye.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: PROPOSED: unpack at least the third, e.g. 'The Bring zero-mode controls how far the prediction sits from the precision target.'
